title: Food Healing
body:
**🍎Are you tired of current hunger system?
Well, I am... but if you are too, then this datapack is for you!🍎**

This datapack introduces a new healing system, based on games like skyrim/zelda botw/other rpgs.

**Features:**
- eating food will regenerate health (natural regeneration is off);
- some foods will give you additional effects;
- sleeping will clear all effects and regenerate your health to full;
- hunger bar converts into stamina bar!

**⚡Stamina Bar:**
You can sprint and jump for 12 seconds, after that you will get tired.
Stamina regenerates naturally while you rest.
(Of course you can turn stamina bar off)

**Exhausted effect:**
Hunger effect is changed to exhausted status. While "exhausted" your stamina won't regenerate, so look out for husks!

**Settings:**
> Disable stamina: /function food_healing_settings:stamina_off

> Uninstall: /function food_healing_settings:uninstall

>  Not working? Try: /function base:load
